tiktok.caption: You can get a raise and actually take home LESS money. The benefit cliff is real and 50M Americans are standing on one right now.

youtube_short.title: The $1 Raise That Costs You $3,200
title_alternatives: Earning $1 More Can Cost You $3,200 — Here's Why
Why Your Raise Might Actually Make You Poorer
youtube_short.description: One extra dollar in income can legally strip away thousands in government benefits — and your employer has no idea. The ACA subsidy cliff hits at $58,320 for a single person in 2026: earn $58,321 and you lose $3,200 in annual health subsidies overnight. Stack that with SNAP, housing vouchers, and childcare subsidies and a single raise can cost you $12,500 or more. Before you say yes to your next promotion, search 'benefit cliff calculator' — it's completely free. Know your number before you negotiate. #personalfinance #benefitcliff #moneytips #financetok #savemoney
